event_title: 17th Mile towards Tsomgo Lake, near Kyongsala, Sikkim
event_description: A major landslide at 17th Mile towards Tsomgo Lake has become a major factor of disappointment for the tourists visiting Sikkim. Almost all the tourists visiting Sikkim have expressed dissatisfaction for losing their chance to visit the famous high altitude lake. The State Police Department, Check Post has stopped issuing permits to tourists visiting Tsomgo Lake, Baba Mandir and Nathu-La border following massive landslides, which occurred near Kyongsala on July 26.
